classification.difficultyReason: Convert journey and circumference to common units, divide by one revolution's distance and round.

content.prompt:
Faith goes on a 12 km bike ride. The wheels of her bike each have diameter 55 cm.
How many revolutions do her wheels make in the journey? Give your answer to the nearest whole revolution.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}C&=\pi d\\C&=\pi\times55\\C&=55\pi\text{ cm}\\\text{Journey distance}&=1\,200\,000\text{ cm}\\\text{Revolutions}&=\frac{1\,200\,000}{55\pi}\\\text{Revolutions}&\approx6945\end{align*}$$
Each wheel makes approximately $6945$ revolutions.
